body.name: Matrix-valued monomial-symmetrized FOBI confidence set
body.construction: Define the labelled matrix set \(\mathcal E_m=\{R\in\mathcal U_q:\sqrt m\,\|\operatorname{vec}(R-\widehat U_m)\|_2\leq c_{m,1-\alpha}\}\) and its quotient-invariant lift \(K_m=\{\ell(MR):R\in\mathcal E_m,\ M\in\mathcal G_q\}\). Equivalently, \(K_m\) is the union of the \(2^q q!\) signed-row-permutation images of \(\mathcal E_m\); arbitrary nonzero row scales are removed by \(\ell\).
